newsitem.title: UK: Danes perfect hyper-sensitive bionic arm.
newsitem.headline: Danes perfect hyper-sensitive bionic arm.

text.p: Danish researchers on Thursday said they had perfected a new bionic arm technique that will help people with paralysed arms develop a more sensitive grip.
A tiny platinum cuff attached to a sensory nerve in the palm automatically adjusts the strength of the grip to prevent the patient from dropping or crushing the object they are holding.
"Our patient doesn't have to look at his grasp all the time," Andreas Lickel of Denmark's Aalborg University told the New Scientist weekly.
"The system takes care of it and corrects his grasp when an object slips," he added.

Laboratory tests on a patient with electrodes planted in his arm muscles and the platinum cuff in his hand showed he could automatically adjust his grip to tell the difference between silk and sandpaper.
